product.title: Riobel 2 GPM Multi Function Rain Shower Head
product.long_description: Elevate your shower experience with the Riobel 2 GPM Multi Function Rain Shower Head. Crafted from durable brass and featuring a modern design, this shower head offers six spray patterns for a customizable shower. The premier finishing process ensures resistance to corrosion and tarnishing. Easy to install with standard U.S. plumbing connections, it includes all necessary hardware and a shower arm.
bullet_points: 6 spray patterns for a customizable shower experience
Easy installation with standard U.S. plumbing connections
